idea-plugin.name: Branch Health Dashboard
idea-plugin.description:
Monitor, score, and clean up your Git branches — right inside your IDE

Branch Health Dashboard gives every Git branch a health score from 0 to 100. It tracks branch age, monitors activity, predicts merge conflicts, and recommends the best merge strategy — all without leaving your editor. Stop letting stale branches silently accumulate risk.

Branch Health Scoring

  • Health score (0–100) — A single number that tells you how healthy each branch is, based on age, activity, behind-count, and conflict risk.
  • Color-coded status — Healthy (≥75, green), Aging (≥50, yellow), Stale (≥25, orange), Dead (<25, red).
  • Score breakdown — Age (up to −40 pts), Activity (+10 to −10 pts), Behind count (up to −15 pts), Conflict risk (up to −20 pts).

Branch Monitoring

  • Age tracking — See how old each branch is at a glance. Color-coded: Healthy ≤7 days, Aging 7–30 days, Stale >30 days.
  • Activity heatmap — Commits-per-day visualization with trend indicators for each branch.
  • Stale branch detection — Configurable thresholds (7, 14, 30, 60, or 90 days) with balloon notifications when branches go stale.
  • Branch comparison — Ahead/behind counts against the base branch so you know exactly how far each branch has drifted.

Tool Window Dashboard

  • Sortable table — Sort branches by health score, age, or activity.
  • Filter by status — Show only Healthy, Aging, Stale, or Dead branches.
  • All branches in one view — Local and remote branches displayed together with full metrics.
  • Conflict prediction — Detects common files across branches and assigns a risk level: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL.
  • Rebase advisor — Recommends the optimal merge strategy for each branch: REBASE, MERGE, or EITHER.
  • Cleanup automation — Batch-delete merged branches with dry-run support. Protected branches (main, master, develop) are never removed.
  • Orphan commit detection — Finds commits that are no longer reachable from any branch.
  • Enhanced notifications — Team notifications and branch policy enforcement to keep everyone aligned.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 or later (builds 243–252.*)
  • Git4Idea plugin (bundled with IntelliJ IDEA)
  • Java 17+

Support

  • Documentation: github.com/JirakJ/branch-health-dashboard/docs
  • Issue tracker: github.com/JirakJ/branch-health-dashboard/issues
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com

idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New

  • Health Score (0-100) - Composite score based on branch age, activity, divergence, and conflict risk
  • Stale Branch Detection - Color-coded health levels with configurable age thresholds
  • Activity Heatmap - Visualize commit frequency and trends per branch
  • Branch Comparison - Ahead/behind visualization against base branch
  • Health Notifications - Balloon alerts when branch health drops below thresholds
  • Conflict Prediction - Detect common files across branches and calculate merge risk
  • Rebase Advisor - Get rebase vs merge recommendations based on branch topology
  • Cleanup Automation - Batch-delete merged branches with dry-run mode and branch protection
